mechanism: Hydrocortisone increases nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity risk of gentamicin while masking infection signs through immunosuppression; gentamicin may reduce corticosteroid efficacy and increase hypokalemia risk.
action: Monitor renal function closely, maintain adequate hydration, use lowest effective doses, monitor for ototoxic and nephrotoxic signs, and consider therapeutic drug monitoring of gentamicin levels.
